args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring already specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build to fail in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`
- Pass `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to `Decimal.quantize`

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`:
- `Decimal("2.675")` → `2.68`
- `Decimal("2.665")` → `2.66` (banker's rounding)
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
